description: Isla is a modern, peaceful beachfront apartment in Corcega, Rincón! Nestled on the second floor of a picturesque Rincón Ocean Club, this stunning private unit offers breathtaking ocean views. Stepping in, you'll catch your first glimpse of the living room, which is fully furnished with comfortable seating, a TV, and high-speed WiFi.The apartment features two cozy bedrooms, each thoughtfully designed to provide a comfortable retreat after a day of beachside adventures.The spaceThe cozy living room and dining area feature a spacious four-person table and amenities. Here, you can enjoy your meals while marveling at the magnificent ocean view. The kitchen is well-equipped with a stove, brand-new refrigerator, freezer, cooking utensils, and other essential appliances.The master bedroom boasts a queen-size bed, air-conditioning, a closet with hangers, and an en-suite bathroom. The second bedroom offers air conditioning, two full-size beds, and a closet with hangers. Across the hallway, you'll find a second bathroom, and just opposite, there's a laundry room in the kitchen equipped with a washer and dryer. A glass sliding door leads to your balcony, where you can enjoy a breathtaking view of the Caribbean Ocean. Throughout your stay, you'll be serenaded by the soothing sound of the ocean waves, creating an unforgettable experience.Guest accessIsla is a charming oceanfront apartment located on the second floor of the Rincón Ocean Club. To enter the building, collect keys and a beeper from the lockbox. You'll pass through a gated main entrance and have access to your designated parking space. *Very Important*- The building has no elevator.- Renovations are being done on the premises.We are always available for our guests, offer personal one-to-one service, and have a team of experts who can create a tailor-made request for you. We will surely delight and surprise you by developing ideas and high-quality programs for a total destination experience. Once your reservation has been confirmed, our concierge service team will contact you. Don't hesitate to contact me if you need additional service or suggestions on what to experience during your vacation.Other things to note**The complex is undergoing renovations and will be adding future communal features. -IMPORTANT NOTE:This property DOES NOT have a pool onsite. It DOES NOT have direct access to the beach.A secluded beach is just a short walk away (~3-5 mins), or you can take a quick drive.-IMPORTANT NOTE:For the safety of our guests, we ask all children 12 and under be accompanied by an adult when accessing the balcony area.[DISCLAIMERS]- No smoking in or outside of this home. Subject to a $500 fine.- Maximum of 4 guests. Occupancy and noise limits are vigorously enforced. Subject to fines that can reach up to $1,000 per violation.- Lost Keys replacement fee of $300 All cancellation policies are respected; you must contact Airbnb for any dispute.Any damages to our home will incur additional charges.- Lost Towels or Damage Towels by Makeup or other stains- Damage or missing bed sheet setsDue to our island's recent atmospheric events, power, water, and internet outages may occasionally occur unexpectedly. Unfortunately, this situation is beyond our control, and we’re not responsible for any inconvenience it may cause during your stay. This property does NOT have a power generator or cistern, and we can't install them due to complex rules.*Additional Information / Fees Apply:If you'd like, we can pre-provision the house before guests arrive. A 20% service charge will be added to the total shopping bill. Other services: - Travel arrangements available/Airline Tickets- Car Rentals- Charters - Private Transportation - Private Tours- Event Planning - Private Chef Services - Private Dinners - Masseuse - Fitness Trainer - Yoga Instructor For more information, visit our website: The Reserve PR.

title: Mareo's Apartment • Explore Rincón & Beaches

images.caption: Living Room: Kick off your shoes and relax in our cozy living room with a comfortable sofa and TV, the ultimate spot for unwinding after a day exploring Rincón.
Sofa Bed: Rest easy knowing this comfortable living room sofa converts into a plush queen-size bed, accommodating 1–2 guests and ensuring everyone in your group of 4 has a great night’s sleep.

Kitchenette: Fully equipped for your island getaway! Featuring a 2-burner stovetop, microwave, and a compact refrigerator, it has everything you need to brew fresh coffee, prep breakfast, or store your beach snacks in Rincón.
Dining Area: Gather round! This stylish table comfortably seats up to 4 guests, making it the perfect spot for family breakfasts, morning coffee, or plotting your next surf session in Rincón.
Master Bedroom: Retreat to your private oasis. Featuring a plush Queen bed with premium linens, it’s the perfect place to recharge after a day of sun, surf, and sunsets in Rincón.

Bathroom: Clean, modern, and accessible. Featuring a step-free shower entry, it’s designed for your total comfort. We provide a hairdryer and all the essentials for a refreshing start to your day in Rincón.
Balcony & Hammock: Your ultimate chill spot. Sway in the hammock, catch the island breeze, and enjoy a peaceful moment surrounded by lush greenery after a day in Rincón.
Private Balcony: Step out onto this spacious, breezy balcony that leads directly to your ultimate relaxation spot—the hammock! An airy, private walkway to enjoy the fresh island air.

Private Entrance: Enjoy the freedom and privacy of your own space. With your own independent entry, you can come and go as you please, making it easy to plan your Rincón adventures without any hassle.
Nature View: Relax in the hammock while enjoying the peaceful view of lush greenery and tropical vegetation surrounding the property.

Tres Palmas Area: Experience world-famous sunsets just minutes from your doorstep. Located less than 5 minutes away from the iconic Tres Palmas in Rincón, you're never far from the best surf, coastal views, and marine reserves.

Punta Higuera Lighthouse: Explore the iconic Rincón lighthouse, located just minutes away. A historic spot offering stunning ocean views, whale watching in season, and some of the best sunset views on the island.
Gated Parking: Designated parking for Mareo’s Apartment is located at the top of the property, directly in front of Mareo’s Guest House.
Board Games: Enjoy a selection of board games for some fun and entertainment during your stay. Perfect for relaxing and spending quality time together.
Rafael Hernández Airport, located less than 30 minutes from the apartment.

Lighthouse Sunset Views: Experience breathtaking golden hour sunsets just minutes from the property. The historic Rincón Lighthouse area is the ultimate spot to end your day taking in the stunning ocean views.
Rincón has a vibrant nightlife with beachfront bars, live music, and a relaxed atmosphere, as well as lively spots in the town center—all just minutes from Mareo’s Guest House.
World-Class Surf Nearby: Catch the waves! Rincón is famous for its incredible surf spots, and you'll be just minutes away from the best local breaks to watch or ride the waves.

title: Villa Bonet-Jacuzzi•Pool •Beach•Solar System for 6
description: Spacious Solar-Powered Home Steps from Marina Beach: Experience coastal living at its best in this fully equipped, solar-powered home located in a secure gated community—just steps from Marina Beach. Spend your days paddleboarding, snorkeling, kayaking, surfing, scuba diving, or even horseback riding—all within a short 2-minute walk. When the sun sets, head to downtown Rincón, famous for its breathtaking sunsets, beautiful beaches, and vibrant restaurants. Your perfect tropical escape awaits!The spaceWelcome to Villa Bonet at Puerto Bahía - Villa Bonet offers a luxurious and comfortable stay with 3 air-conditioned bedrooms, each featuring queen beds, and 2.5 baths. Enjoy high-speed internet, a beautifully furnished living room, and a stylish dining area for six. Relax in the separate TV room equipped with a 55" Vizio Smart TV, air-conditioning, and a cozy sofa for Netflix and chill. The villa is fully equipped with everything you need, including a full-size washer/dryer, first aid kit, beach towels, chairs, cooler, and snorkeling gear. Step outside to a private backyard oasis complete with a jacuzzi, barbecue, outdoor furniture, shower, sunshade sail, and charming fiesta string lights for serene evenings. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, including a microwave, stove, fridge, toaster, and coffee maker, plus all the pots, pans, and utensils you’ll need for a home-cooked meal. The Puerto Bahía complex also offers a pool with a shaded picnic area and restrooms.Discover the beauty of Rincón while staying in this peaceful, solar-powered villa. No smoking, and accommodates up to 6 guests.Guest accessConvenient Check-In/Out with Private Access - Enjoy seamless check-in and check-out with private front gate access and a smart lock system. Upon arrival, you’ll be provided with keys for both the pool area and front gate for easy, secure entry throughout your stay.Other things to noteAccessibility Note - This is a two-floor home with stairs leading to the bedrooms, which may not be ideal for guests with mobility challenges, including those using wheelchairs or senior citizens.

description: Welcome to Casa Caleta! A spacious modern duplex featuring two private 3-bedroom/2-bathroom apartments, a heated pool & jacuzzi, outdoor kitchen, and unbeatable walkability to beaches, restaurants, and downtown.Perfect for families or groups seeking comfort, privacy, and resort-style amenities in a quiet neighborhood.Please note: Casa Caleta is NOT a party house. We kindly ask all guests to be respectful of our neighbors at all times.The spaceThe first floor has a modern fully equipped kitchen open to dining and seating area with French doors leading out to the pool deck and outdoor kitchen! A full hallway bathroom is also accessible from the pool area. The primary bedroom has a queen bed, full bathroom, lounge chair, closet organizer, inverter AC, and private entrance with access to a furnished front porch. The second bedroom has two queens beds, a desk, inverter AC, open closet and views of the pool. The third bedroom has a queen bed, closet organizer, lounge chair, night tables, lamps, private entrance, and access to the game room. The game room features a Playstation 5, 65” TV, Netflix,wifi, etc, plus two comfortable leather couches. There is also a laundry room equipped with washer/dryer cleaning products, utility sink, and detergent. The second story features a veranda where you can enjoy views of the courtyard, pool deck and the beautiful skyline at Sunsets. The formal living room has wifi, a 75" TV, Netflix, etc, and board games. The stylish modern dine-in kitchen is fully stocked with everything you need to feel at home. There is a shared full bathroom outfitted with all the toiletries, soaps, shampoo, conditioner and other bath/self care products you may need. The first bedroom has two queen size beds, open closet, large mirror and inverter AC unit. The second bedroom has a queen size bed, open closet, large mirror and inverter AC unit. There is also a stackable washer and dryer in the hallway stocked with cleaning products and detergent. Lastly our super King size bedroom is very spacious, comfortable and furnished with a modern lounge chair, dresser, closet organizer, puff seating, large mirror, 65” TV, Netflix etc... There is a large full bathroom outfitted with all the toiletries, soaps, shampoo, conditioner and other bath/self care products you may need. The bathroom connects to a bonus guest room offering a futon, work desk, baby high chair, baby crib and iron.The outdoor space has a fabulous heated pool with outdoor bar/kitchen with high chairs, fridge, stove with oven, and propane BBQ grill. There is also a dining table and lounge seating. We offer some snorkeling gear, cooler, beach chairs, beach umbrella and other beach items.Guest accessGuests have access to the entire property.You would NOT be sharing any part of the property with any other guests.Other things to noteBQN (Aguadilla) is the closest airport to Casa Caleta. About 35 minutes away.While we highly recommend renting a vehicle to explore the beauty of Puerto Rico at your own pace. Casa Caleta is conveniently located within walking distance to all your essential needs.
